lines.intro: Lesson five is free play: make your own game, with every block.
lines.start: It starts with just {start}when the game starts. The rest is up to you.
lines.solution: Stuck for ideas? {click}Show me the solution loads an example: {ship}a ship that turns, flies, and fires at rocks.
lines.ship: The ship turns and flies with the arrow keys, and fires a shot with space.
lines.shot: Each shot flies forty steps, then deletes itself.
lines.rock: The rocks drift and bounce, and explode when a shot touches them.
lines.playing: Hit all five rocks to win.
lines.tips: Every block has a tip: {hover}hold the mouse over it to read what it does.
lines.playground: And {link}Open in the playground takes the DIV code of your blocks to the text editor, to go on in real code.
lines.outro: That's all the lessons. {next}Have fun making your own games!
